EC1: - Patients who refuse to participate in the study
EC2: - prenatally diagnosed fetal pathology (intrauterine growth restriction, [OR] malformation, [OR] genetics disorders)
EC3: - adherent placenta, an adnexal mass [OR] or a myoma at the lower uterine segment
EC4: - Cesarean section in a context of medical [OR] or obstetrical emergency
EC5: - Caesarean section [AND] with a high risk of bleeding
